_comment: RAD COUNTER RULE (Mariposa Military Base). The rule is inherent to the counter type, not printed on the card: at the beginning of each player's precombat main they mill a number of cards equal to their rad counters, and for each NONLAND milled they lose 1 life and remove one counter. Staged with 2 counters because the counters only arrive from an optional land-ETB mode the search currently declines, which would otherwise leave the mill untested. library_filler is Peregrine Drake (a NONLAND), so the first precombat main mills 2, costs 2 life, and removes BOTH counters -- after which the mill stops. Hence exactly 2 life lost no matter how many turns run: 20 - 2 = 18. That decay is the assertion's real content; a mill that failed to remove counters would keep draining and land well below 18. It also guards the zone-card mask trap -- a graveyard/library card has empty type masks, so testing IsLand() on the zone card instead of the DEFINITION would make every milled card read as a nonland here and, on a land-heavy mill, drain life that should never be lost.
